comments.why: Lerdorf explains PHP function parameter order inconsistency
comments.text: Rasmus Lerdorf has talked about it in other videos but this is one [VIDEO] Basically, groups of functions are consistent: string,array etc. Their parameter order was usually based on whatever the underlying C API was.

comments.author: ptx
comments.why: Lerdorf on PHP's origin as a templating system for C
comments.text: PHP certainly works just fine when used well, but what in particular makes it a great introductory language? (As for what's (arguably) wrong with it, have a look at this talk[1] by Rasmus Lerdorf about its creation. He intended it as a quick and dirty templating system for C programs. Because it was never designed to be a programming language, but somehow organically grew into one, it lacks (in the eyes of some) the elegance of a purposefully designed language.) [1] [VIDEO]
